name: Get Child Samples
description: List the child samples VMRay found inside a sample (files in an archive or email, files a URL downloaded, ...), with their verdict, hashes and VTI score — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay ID of the parent sample — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Samples By Hash or Submit File Sample.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Submit File Sample. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

max_depth.description: How many levels of child samples to follow (at most 10): 1 lists only the direct children, 2 adds their children, and so on.
max_depth.title: Max depth

min_verdict.description: Only return children whose verdict is at least this severe. Allowed values: 'clean' (every child with a known verdict), 'suspicious' (suspicious and malicious) or 'malicious'. Leave empty to return every child. A child that does not match is left out of the list, but its own children are still searched. A value that is not one of these is an error.
min_verdict.title: Minimum verdict

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID of the child.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

parent_sample_id.description: The sample this child was found in (one level up).
parent_sample_id.title: Parent Sample ID

depth.description: 1 for a direct child of the sample asked for, 2 for a child of a child, ...
depth.title: Depth

type.description: VMRay's file type of the child, e.g. 'Windows Exe (x86-64)'.
type.title: Type

verdict.description: VMRay's verdict for the child, e.g. 'malicious'. Empty if unknown.
verdict.title: Verdict

webif_url.description: The child's page in the VMRay console.
webif_url.title: Web link

child_count.description: How many samples VMRay found inside this child.
child_count.title: Child Count

has_children.description: True when at least one child matches (after `min_verdict`).
has_children.title: Has Children

sample_id.description: The parent sample the children were looked up for.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

total_child_count.description: How many children were found in the tree before `min_verdict` was applied.
total_child_count.title: Total Child Count

sample_ids.description: The listed children's sample IDs — input for Build Report.
sample_ids.title: Sample IDs

children.description: The children, nearest levels first, each with its parent and depth.
children.title: Children

errors.description: Children that could not be read, by `child_sample:<id>`.
errors.title: Errors
